edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W gold card has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Syndra Scatter the Weak: 15s flat — the QE stun cone starts every kill combo; stay off the line between her and her orbs, and step up in the window it is down. - Unleashed Power is 120s at rank 1 — above half HP the execute whiffs. - Your W gold card has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: You farm safely at max Wild Cards range and stall to neutral — she only wins if you eat spheres stepping up.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Dodge her spheres and the 15s Scatter and neither side cleanly kills the other — Q the wave, hold ground.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Both squishy at two items: your Wild Cards clear and Destiny picks even the scaling — pick and collapse, never poke-war.

edits.before: At 6 her Unleashed Power is a point-blank execute that one-shots a low Twisted Fate, so respect her sphere count and back off when she has three up; two items in you're both squishy, and your Wild Card clear plus Destiny roams let you even the game with picks rather than a poke war you lose.
